question.text: LP Mr. Vikas Agarwal committed INR 40 crore to 'Lotus Credit AIF'. Cumulative drawdowns so far: 35%. After another drawdown of 15%, what will Mr. Agarwal's TOTAL called capital be?

explanation.text: The Logic: New cumulative = 35% + 15% = 50%. Called capital = 50% x INR 40 cr = INR 20 crore. The Trap: Option A is the 15% new drawdown only. Option B is 35% only. Option D is 65% error.
